items.name: Real activity and business cycle
items.mechanism: Demand, production and employment jointly reveal current growth and recession risk.

items.name: Labor market and wages
items.mechanism: Employment, unemployment and wages transmit household demand and inflation pressure.

items.name: Inflation and prices
items.mechanism: Price momentum, persistence and pass-through determine the inflation path.

items.name: Monetary policy and financial conditions
items.mechanism: Rates and financial conditions transmit policy into activity and assets.

items.name: Fiscal and Treasury supply
items.mechanism: Debt and issuance affect term premia, demand and fiscal-risk pricing.

items.name: Commodity and energy shocks
items.mechanism: Energy supply and prices pass through to inflation and real incomes.

items.name: Housing and household demand
items.mechanism: Housing, wealth, saving and debt service affect consumption.

items.name: Trade and external demand
items.mechanism: Import costs, exports and global demand transmit to prices and output.

items.name: Financial stability
items.mechanism: Leverage and liquidity can amplify otherwise ordinary macro shocks.

items.name: AI adoption, exposure and productivity
items.mechanism: Adoption can substitute for or complement tasks and transmit through vacancies, employment, wages and productivity.
